hook.text: This tiny free model beats OpenAI's Whisper at speech to text, and it's ten times smaller. Here's Phonon-2.
hook.tts: This tiny, free model beats Open A.I.'s Whisper at speech to text, and it is ten times smaller. Here is Phonon two.

headline: A 164 MB
speech model
stories.text: Phonon-2 turns English speech into text. The whole model is a one hundred sixty-four megabyte download, smaller than most phone games.
stories.tts: Phonon two turns English speech into text. The whole model is a one hundred sixty four megabyte download, smaller than most phone games.

headline: More accurate than
Whisper large turbo
stories.text: On the Open ASR Leaderboard it makes five point two errors per hundred words. Whisper large turbo makes six point six, at about ten times the size.
stories.tts: On the Open A.S.R. leaderboard, it makes five point two errors per hundred words. Whisper large turbo makes six point six, at about ten times the size.

headline: 1 hour of audio
in 20 seconds
stories.text: It transcribes an hour of audio in about twenty seconds on a MacBook Air. No cloud, no per-minute fees, and your audio never leaves your device.
stories.tts: It transcribes an hour of audio in about twenty seconds, on a MacBook Air. No cloud, no per minute fees, and your audio never leaves your device.

headline: Free subtitles,
notes, dictation
stories.text: Use it for meeting notes, video subtitles, voice typing and podcast transcripts. It's open, under a CC BY licence, so you can build on it with credit.
stories.tts: Use it for meeting notes, video subtitles, voice typing, and podcast transcripts. It is open, under a C.C. B.Y. licence, so you can build on it, with credit.
